campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 祭壇で落ち合おう。全員でだ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Resolved, steady leadership baritone uniting the company before the final ascent.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 祭壇で落ち合おう。全員でだ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-1.0st">祭壇で落ち合おう。<break time="340ms"/>全員でだ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: İlerideki işareti fark edip alçak ve tetikte bir sesle uyarır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: A signal.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……合図だ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Alert, hushed baritone spotting the lantern signal ahead.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……合図だ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-1.0st"><break time="460ms"/>合図だ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Sable'a güvenip güvenmediğini Fadyme'nin gözlerinin içine bakarak sorar.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You trust her.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……あいつを信じるのか。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Searching, quiet baritone asking if Fadyme truly trusts Sable.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……あいつを信じるのか。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="90%" pitch="-0.9st"><break time="460ms"/>あいつを信じるのか。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Düşmanın sunağa kendilerinden önce varacağını ciddiyetle saptar.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then she reaches the altar before we do.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、あいつは俺たちより先に祭壇へ着く。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Grim, urgent baritone realizing the enemy is half a day ahead on the altar road.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: なら、あいつは俺たちより先に祭壇へ着く。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-1.2st">なら、<break time="200ms"/>あいつは俺たちより先に祭壇へ着く。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Her şey bittiğinde çirkin ama güvenli bir yer bulacaklarını kuru bir sıcaklıkla söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: When this is done, we will find somewhere ugly and safe.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: これが全部終わったら……どこか無骨で、安全な場所を見つけよう。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Dry, warm, wistful baritone dreaming of an ordinary life after the altar.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <exhales> これが全部終わったら……どこか無骨で、安全な場所を見つけよう。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="90%" pitch="-0.8st">これが全部終わったら<break time="460ms"/>どこか無骨で、<break time="200ms"/>安全な場所を見つけよう。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme'nin 'Peynirli olsun' sözüne çok yumuşak, sevgi dolu bir tebessümle 'Evet, peynirli' diye karşılık verir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: With cheese.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……ああ。チーズ付きでな。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Gentle, fond baritone with a quiet smile, echoing their shared joke.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <chuckle> ……ああ。チーズ付きでな。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="89%" pitch="-0.6st"><break time="460ms"/>ああ。<break time="340ms"/>チーズ付きでな。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Akşam yemeğini kaçıran Fadyme'ye yanmamış kısmı ayırdığını gösterişsiz, şefkatli bir sesle söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You missed supper. I saved the part that did not burn.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 夕餉を抜いただろう。焦げなかった分を、取っておいた。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Gentle, understated, caring low baritone; a quiet knight offering saved bread by the fire without making a fuss.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> 夕餉を抜いただろう。焦げなかった分を、取っておいた。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="92%" pitch="-0.8st">夕餉を抜いただろう。<break time="340ms"/>焦げなかった分を、<break time="200ms"/>取っておいた。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme'nin elinin titrediğini fark edip alçak, endişeli bir sesle uyarır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Your hand is shaking.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……手が、震えているぞ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Quiet, attentive concern in a low baritone; noticing her trembling fingers in the cold.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……手が、震えているぞ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="90%" pitch="-1.0st"><break time="460ms"/>手が、<break time="200ms"/>震えているぞ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Kalkanını kaldırıp Fadyme ile Çan Dulunun arasına girer; tavizsiz ve tehditkâr bir kararlılıkla konuşur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You will not take her anywhere.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: お前には、指一本触れさせん。どこへも連れて行かせはしない。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Low, dangerous, unyielding protective baritone; stepping between Fadyme and the Bell-Widow with shield raised.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: お前には、指一本触れさせん。どこへも連れて行かせはしない。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-1.3st">お前には、<break time="200ms"/>指一本触れさせん。<break time="340ms"/>どこへも連れて行かせはしない。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: 'Öyleyse kalkanımın arkasında olmayan birini seçsin' diyerek kadere meydan okur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then it can choose someone who is not under my shield.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、俺の盾の後ろにいない者を勝手に選ぶがいい。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Defiant, iron-willed knight baritone; challenging fate itself without raising his voice into a shout.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: なら、俺の盾の後ろにいない者を、勝手に選ぶがいい。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-1.2st">なら、<break time="200ms"/>俺の盾の後ろにいない者を勝手に選ぶがいい。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme korkmasın diye Yseldra'yı tanımadığını gereğinden biraz fazla hızlı söyleyerek yalan söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: No.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……いや。知らん。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Slightly too-quick, guarded baritone; a protective lie spoken hurriedly in the rain to spare Fadyme fear.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……いや。知らん。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="98%" pitch="-0.9st"><break time="460ms"/>いや。<break time="340ms"/>知らん。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Kılıcını çekip gölgelerin içindeki kişiye 'Göster kendini!' diye gürler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Show yourself.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 姿を現せ！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Low, dangerous warning baritone drawing his blade as footsteps echo on the altar stairs.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 姿を現せ！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="96%" pitch="-1.3st">姿を現せ！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme'nin lanetini yazan kişinin karşısında olduğunu anladığında buz gibi, ölümcül bir öfkeyle konuşur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You made her curse.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 貴様が……彼女の呪いを作ったのか。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Trembling with cold, lethal fury in a low baritone; facing the Clockless Chancellor.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> 貴様が……彼女の呪いを作ったのか。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="88%" pitch="-1.4st">貴様が<break time="460ms"/>彼女の呪いを作ったのか。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme ile amcasının arasına dikilip 'Ya reddedersem?' diye meydan okur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: And if I refuse?
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……断ると言ったら、どうする？

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Guarded, defiant, iron-steady baritone standing between Fadyme and her uncle.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: ……断ると言ったら、どうする？
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="90%" pitch="-1.3st"><break time="460ms"/>断ると言ったら、<break time="200ms"/>どうする？<break time="320ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Bütün bu zaman boyunca Fadyme'nin bu yükü tek başına taşıdığını anladığında sesi titreyerek konuşur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: All this time, you were carrying something alone.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……ずっと、お前はひとりでそれを背負っていたのか。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Shaken, hushed, heartbroken baritone; the truth of her curse finally crashing over him.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……ずっと、お前はひとりでそれを背負っていたのか。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="86%" pitch="-1.1st"><break time="460ms"/>ずっと、<break time="200ms"/>お前はひとりでそれを背負っていたのか。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Kızgınlıktan değil, onun acıyı yalnız çekmiş olmasının verdiği derin sızıyla 'Bana söylemeliydin' der.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You should have told me.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……言ってくれるべきだった。俺にだけでも。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Hurt, vulnerable, aching baritone; not angry at her, but grieving that she suffered alone.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <sigh> ……言ってくれるべきだった。俺にだけでも。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="86%" pitch="-1.1st"><break time="460ms"/>言ってくれるべきだった。<break time="340ms"/>俺にだけでも。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: 'Hayır, sen her yolun bir yere vardığını hissettiren kişisin' derken sesi en derin şefkat ve sevgiyle dolar.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You are. You are the person who made every road feel like it led somewhere.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 違う。……お前は、どんな道も『どこかへ続いている』と思わせてくれた人だ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Deeply tender, emotional, heartfelt baritone; telling her what she truly means to him.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> 違う。……お前は、どんな道も『どこかへ続いている』と思わせてくれた人だ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="87%" pitch="-0.8st">違う。<break time="340ms"/><break time="460ms"/>お前は、<break time="200ms"/>どんな道も『どこかへ続いている』と思わせてくれた人だ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: 'Uyandığında da yanında olacağım' diyerek sarsılmaz bir sevgiyle elini tutar.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: I will stay when you wake, too.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 目が覚めたときも、俺は傍にいる。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Resolved, steady, loving baritone holding her hand.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> 目が覚めたときも、俺は傍にいる。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="88%" pitch="-0.9st">目が覚めたときも、<break time="200ms"/>俺は傍にいる。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Kederi sarsılmaz bir öfkeye ve yemine dönüşür: 'Bu laneti yazan eli bulacağım, son satırı yazmasına izin vermeyeceğim!'
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then I will find the hand that wrote this curse. I will not let it write the last line.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、この呪いを書いた手を見つけ出す。最後の一行など、決して書かせはしない！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Grief surging into fierce, unbreakable resolve; a knight swearing war against the author of her death.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> なら、この呪いを書いた手を見つけ出す。最後の一行など、決して書かせはしない！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-1.1st">なら、<break time="200ms"/>この呪いを書いた手を見つけ出す。<break time="340ms"/>最後の一行など、<break time="200ms"/>決して書かせはしない！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: 'Seni görüyorum... Daha erken görmeliydim' derken derin bir pişmanlık ve şefkatle konuşur.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: I see you. I should have seen you sooner.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 俺が見ているのは、お前だ。……もっと早く、気づいてやるべきだった。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Remorseful, tender baritone; pulling her close with quiet sorrow and devotion.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <sigh> 俺が見ているのは、お前だ。……もっと早く、気づいてやるべきだった。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="86%" pitch="-1.0st">俺が見ているのは、<break time="200ms"/>お前だ。<break time="340ms"/><break time="460ms"/>もっと早く、<break time="200ms"/>気づいてやるべきだった。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Son sırrını da bırakarak Yseldra'yı o gece sunağa çağırırken gördüğünü ve yalan söylediğini dürüstçe itiraf eder.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then I have one more thing to confess. I knew Yseldra. I saw her call you to the altar that night, and I told you I did not know her.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、俺にもひとつ告白することがある。……俺はイゼルドラを知っていた。あの夜、あいつがお前を祭壇へ呼ぶのを見ていながら、知らぬと嘘をついた。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Ashamed, completely honest baritone laying down his last secret before her.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> なら、俺にもひとつ告白することがある。<sigh> ……俺はイゼルドラを知っていた。あの夜、あいつがお前を祭壇へ呼ぶのを見ていながら、知らぬと嘘をついた。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="87%" pitch="-1.1st">なら、<break time="200ms"/>俺にもひとつ告白することがある。<break time="340ms"/><break time="460ms"/>俺はイゼルドラを知っていた。<break time="340ms"/>あの夜、<break time="200ms"/>あいつがお前を祭壇へ呼ぶのを見ていながら、<break time="200ms"/>知らぬと嘘をついた。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Çan sesi kesilince son kurdun kaçtığını dikkatle gözlemler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: The last one ran when the bell stopped.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 鐘が止んだ途端、最後の一頭は逃げていったな。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Watchful, post-battle low baritone; lowering his weapon slightly while scanning the mist.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <exhales> 鐘が止んだ途端、最後の一頭は逃げていったな。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-0.9st">鐘が止んだ途端、<break time="200ms"/>最後の一頭は逃げていったな。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Üç kurdu tespit eder etmez Fadyme'yi kalkanının arkasına alır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Three wolves. Stay behind my shield.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 狼が三頭だ。俺の盾の後ろにいろ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Alert, commanding combat baritone; calm tactical authority as ash wolves emerge.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 狼が三頭だ。俺の盾の後ろにいろ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="96%" pitch="-1.1st">狼が三頭だ。<break time="340ms"/>俺の盾の後ろにいろ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Bir sonraki tapınaktan çok daha uzak bir hedef olduğunu kuru bir mizahla belirtir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: That is farther than the next shrine.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 次の祠よりも、ずいぶん遠い場所だな。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Wry, dryly observant baritone; understated veteran humor.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <exhales> 次の祠よりも、ずいぶん遠い場所だな。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-0.7st">次の祠よりも、<break time="200ms"/>ずいぶん遠い場所だな。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Çöken kirişi tek başına tutmaya çalışan Brin'e güven veren bir sesle yardıma gelir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You do not have to hold it alone.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ひとりで支えなくていい。俺たちも手を貸す。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Steady, reassuring baritone; stepping in to shoulder the collapsing shrine beam beside Brin.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: ひとりで支えなくていい。俺たちも手を貸す。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-0.8st">ひとりで支えなくていい。<break time="340ms"/>俺たちも手を貸す。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Önce ölüleri temizleyip ardından eşyaları toplamaya yardım edeceklerini sakin bir dille söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: We can help you gather them after the dead are gone.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 死者どもを片づけたあとで、一緒に集めるのを手伝おう。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Calm, practical, grounded baritone; offering help once the immediate danger is cleared.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 死者どもを片づけたあとで、一緒に集めるのを手伝おう。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-0.8st">死者どもを片づけたあとで、<break time="200ms"/>一緒に集めるのを手伝おう。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Ağaca tırmanarak mı bunu öğrendiğini sorarken hafif şüpheci ama tatlı bir şaşkınlık taşır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: And you learned that by climbing a tree?
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 木に登って、それを知ったというのか？

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Dryly skeptical, amused low baritone; raising an eyebrow at Nixie up in the branches.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 木に登って、それを知ったというのか？
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-0.6st">木に登って、<break time="200ms"/>それを知ったというのか？<break time="320ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Savaş sonrası Fadyme'nin buz kesmiş elini tuttuğunda sesindeki sertlik yerini derin bir endişeye bırakır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Your hand is freezing.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……お前の手、氷のように冷たいぞ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Deep, hushed concern; holding her freezing hand in the rain after the boss fight.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……お前の手、氷のように冷たいぞ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="89%" pitch="-1.0st"><break time="460ms"/>お前の手、<break time="200ms"/>氷のように冷たいぞ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Ön hattı sabit tutarken arka hatta canavarın çenesinin açılmasını beklemeleri için net bir savaş emri verir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Front line, hold. Rear line, wait for the jaw to open.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 前衛は踏みとどまれ！　後衛は、顎が開く瞬間を待て！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……お母上の肖像画がここにあるとは、言わなかったな。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Gentle, hushed baritone standing beside Fadyme before her late mother's portrait.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……お母上の肖像画がここにあるとは、言わなかったな。

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: あの肖像画にも……針のない懐中時計が描かれていたな。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Grim, observant low baritone connecting the clue in the family portrait.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> あの肖像画にも……針のない懐中時計が描かれていたな。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Çocuğu tuttuğunu söyleyerek Fadyme'ye çöken kemeri bırakması için acil çağrı yapar.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Let the arch go. I have the child.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: アーチから手を離せ！　子どもは俺が抱えている！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Urgent, commanding baritone rescuing the child under the collapsing archway.

campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then we find the altar before the next line is written.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、次の行が書かれる前に祭壇を見つけ出す。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Resolved, urgent baritone after discovering the succession ledger.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: なら、次の行が書かれる前に、祭壇を見つけ出す。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: O hatırayı burada sonlandıracaklarını vakur ve kararlı bir sesle söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Then we end the memory.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: なら、その記憶をここで終わらせよう。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Solemn, commanding baritone facing the noble's wraith.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: なら、その記憶をここで終わらせよう。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-1.1st">なら、<break time="200ms"/>その記憶をここで終わらせよう。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Cevabı birlikte bulacaklarını ve kimsenin tek başına önden gitmeyeceğini koruyucu bir bağlılıkla söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: We find the answer together. No one goes ahead alone.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 答えは一緒に見つける。誰ひとり、先へは行かせない。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Protective, deeply devoted baritone looking directly at Fadyme.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 答えは一緒に見つける。誰ひとり、先へは行かせない。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Yeterince şey yaptığını söyleyerek herkesi sağ salim eve götürmesini minnetle ister.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You have already done enough. Get everyone home.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: あんたはもう十分すぎるほどやってくれた。皆を連れて帰れ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Grateful, warm veteran baritone thanking an ally holding the rear.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: あんたはもう十分すぎるほどやってくれた。皆を連れて帰れ。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="93%" pitch="-0.8st">あんたはもう十分すぎるほどやってくれた。<break time="340ms"/>皆を連れて帰れ。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Veyr?
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……ヴェア、だと？

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Surprised, hushed baritone realizing the royal house name inscribed on the altar.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……ヴェア、だと？
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="89%" pitch="-0.9st"><break time="460ms"/>ヴェア、<break time="200ms"/>だと？<break time="320ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Fadyme'nin 'Biraz yanımda kal' ricasına 'Sen istediğin sürece' diyerek sonsuz bir bağlılıkla karşılık verir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: As long as you ask me to.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ああ。お前が望む限り、いつまでも傍にいる。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Deeply gentle, devoted low baritone; an unconditional vow spoken quietly.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ああ。お前が望む限り、いつまでも傍にいる。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="88%" pitch="-0.8st">ああ。<break time="340ms"/>お前が望む限り、<break time="200ms"/>いつまでも傍にいる。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Tek başına söz vermek zorunda olmadığını, yanında olduğunu şefkatle söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: You do not have to promise alone.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ひとりで約束しなくていい。俺もここにいる。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Tender, unwavering baritone; sharing the weight of her promise.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ひとりで約束しなくていい。俺もここにいる。

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ファディメ、俺の後ろに下がれ！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Alarmed, urgent combat cry as the Eclipse Construct unleashes its phase-2 ward.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: ファディメ、俺の後ろに下がれ！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="99%" pitch="-0.8st">ファディメ、<break time="200ms"/>俺の後ろに下がれ！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Savaş bittiğinde Fadyme'nin elindeki kararmayı ilk kez görüp korku ve şokla donakalır.

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ファディメ……！？　お前の手、それは——

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Sudden, breathless fear and shock as he sees the black curse veins spreading across her hand.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ファディメ……！？ お前の手、それは——

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 俺たち五人だ。これより酷い戦線も、共に打ち破ってきた。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Steady, inspiring knight baritone before the final altar construct.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 俺たち五人だ。これより酷い戦線も、共に打ち破ってきた。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-1.0st">俺たち五人だ。<break time="340ms"/>これより酷い戦線も、<break time="200ms"/>共に打ち破ってきた。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.en: It can have mine first.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 名前を求めるなら、まず俺の名前からくれてやる。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Certain, fierce, unhesitating baritone; ready to give his own name before hers.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 名前を求めるなら、まず俺の名前からくれてやる。

campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Mahmut. No title. The crest came off years ago. The shield did not.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: マフムトだ。肩書きはない。紋章なら何年も前に剥がれたが、この盾だけは残っている。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Grounded, weathered knight baritone introducing himself without pretension.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> マフムトだ。肩書きはない。紋章なら何年も前に剥がれたが、この盾だけは残っている。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Ön hattı devraldığını güven veren tok bir sesle bildirir.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Front line. Mine.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 前衛は、俺が引き受ける。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Steady, reliable low baritone stepping into the front line.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 前衛は、俺が引き受ける。
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="94%" pitch="-1.0st">前衛は、<break time="200ms"/>俺が引き受ける。<break time="340ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Dinlenmesini bekliyorlarsa çok bekleyeceklerini kuru bir asker mizahıyla söyler.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: If you are waiting for me to rest, it will be a long wait.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 俺が休むのを待っているなら、ずいぶん長い待ち時間になるぞ。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Dry, quietly amused veteran baritone.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <exhales> 俺が休むのを待っているなら、ずいぶん長い待ち時間になるぞ。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Temel saldırıda hattı tutan tok savaş komutu.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Hold.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 踏みとどまれ！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Firm, heavy shield-bash combat baritone.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 踏みとどまれ！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="98%" pitch="-1.1st">踏みとどまれ！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Aktif yetenekte müttefiklerini kalkanının arkasına alır.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Behind me.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 俺の後ろへ！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Urgent, protective vanguard baritone raising his shield wall.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: 俺の後ろへ！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="98%" pitch="-1.0st">俺の後ろへ！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Ultimate yeteneğinde 'Son duvar burası, sakın geri adım atmayın!' diye kükreyen sarsılmaz komutan sesi.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Last wall. Stand fast!
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ここが最後の壁だ——一歩も退くな！

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Heroic, roaring yet controlled veteran commander baritone; unbreakable bastion ultimate.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: ここが最後の壁だ——一歩も退くな！
campaign_and_vo_lines.ssml_chirp3: <speak><prosody rate="97%" pitch="-1.2st">ここが最後の壁だ<break time="380ms"/>一歩も退くな！<break time="300ms"/></prosody></speak>

speech_metadata.style: Relieved, grounded post-battle baritone checking on his companions first.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <exhales> 全員、立っているか？ ……なら上出来だ。

campaign_and_vo_lines.subtext_tr: Yenilgi anında geç kaldığı için duyduğu derin pişmanlık.
campaign_and_vo_lines.en: ...I was too slow.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……俺が、遅すぎたか……。

speech_metadata.speaker: Mahmut
speech_metadata.style: Breathless, devastated low baritone falling to one knee.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <sigh> ……俺が、遅すぎたか……。

campaign_and_vo_lines.en: Not yet.
campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: ……まだだ。まだ倒れん。

speech_metadata.style: Gritty, strained, unyielding baritone bracing behind his cracked shield.

campaign_and_vo_lines.tts_text_gemini38: <breath> ……まだだ。まだ倒れん。

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: あいつはいつも『平気だ』と言う。……俺はもう、その回数を数えるようになった。

speech_metadata.style: Quietly worried, tender low baritone speaking of Fadyme's habit of hiding her pain.

campaign_and_vo_lines.ja: 盾の扱いはあの人に教わった。……だが、それ以外のことで礼を言うつもりはない。
